correctness.rationale: Exact Bloch matrix from Lindblad commutator/dephaser has eigenvalues -2kappa and -kappa±i sqrt(omega²-kappa²). Solving each memory Volterra mode gives nonvanishing leading Kummer power, and exact algebra yields beta_yz-beta_x=q(omega²-2kappa²-kappa*q)/[(q+2kappa)(q²+2kappa*q+omega²)]. Its sign proves all positive-q cases and the unique threshold. Nonzero spectral projections guarantee observable sector dominance. Standalone exact symbolic identities and independent real six-state integral evolution checks passed; no finite sampling replaces the proof.

value.rationale: Gives a complete mode-selection phase boundary for a physically natural noisy driven qubit with nonlocal reset history, distinguishing monotone from logarithmically oscillatory slow polarization under the same stationary maximally mixed state. The threshold is necessary and sufficient for every positive rate and drive-to-dephasing ratio in the regime, providing a reusable open-system benchmark rather than an unmotivated narrow numerical case.
